name: Babel Brush
description: Admin form to search core Locale source strings by keyword and bulk-delete selected strings from locales_source and locales_target.
project_description: Babel Brush is a small maintenance utility for Drupal's core Locale (interface translation) system. It adds a single admin form under Configuration → Regional and language that searches translatable source strings by keyword (a LIKE match against locales_source.source) and lets an administrator tick individual results (or use Select all / Deselect all) and delete them. Deleting removes the matching rows from both the locales_source and locales_target tables, so it clears the source string together with all its translations. It is aimed at cleaning out stale, obsolete, or unwanted translatable strings. Version 1.0.0-alpha1; alpha, minimally maintained, no coverage by the security advisory policy.
